ends.note: north end: stops at the rear line of the Marshall Avenue lots (block 8), which runs across the street
west end at the Miami Canal tow path (east side of the canal)

notes: Names printed without a suffix (HEYWOOD, STRAIGHT, COOK, ALFRED, KLOTTMAN) are written with 'Street'. Marshall's north line is off the top; Marshall points use the south line (y~231-303) plus the printed 60' (centre y~56-108, on the paper). Massachusetts flares at Marshall (the corner lot at 4172,231 is set back ~40 px); the point follows the street's main lines and its water pipe. Heywood jogs at Massachusetts: west of it Heywood is 50' (lines y~1396/1674), east of it the street is 30' (lines y~1584/1763) and ~140 px further south; the east piece carries no name on this sheet, but the address numbers continue (1041/1040 -> 1036/1035 -> 1017/1018) and the facing sheet 256 shows '...YWOOD' at the gutter, so it is named 'Heywood Street (east of Massachusetts)'; two T points. Heywood ends at Colerain (T; nothing opposite on the 254 side). Cormany runs from its north dead end south across Heywood (Heywood continues east onto 256, so cross) and leaves the right edge before Straight (Cormany/Straight is off the sheet). Cormany has no printed width (~45-50 ft as drawn, compressed by the gutter); the Cormany/Heywood point is near the binding and may be ~10-15 px off. Cook (north of Alfred) is at the left edge: its west line is lost in the gutter at Straight, so the Cook/Straight point uses the east line, the printed 50' and the water pipe. Alfred's south line is off the bottom; the Alfred points use the north line (y~7493-7505) plus the printed 60'. Alfred ends at Colerain (T); the 255 block east of Colerain runs to the canal. Massachusetts ends at Straight (T). Straight continues east past the canal into sheet 256 (no end recorded). West McMillan Street (40') is at the bottom right east of the canal, but only its north line is on the paper (y~7601-7615) and its centre (~7729) is below the paper edge, so its west end at the canal is not recorded. Klottman (no width printed, ~44 ft as drawn) and McMillan lie east of the canal (sheet 256/248 territory) but are drawn here. Canal ignored. Circled figures are grade elevations. No alleys.
